entities.summary: Roman, a notable figure in the history of Montenegro, associated with Illyrian & Roman Doclea (168 BCE–476). Preceded by Roman defeat of Illyrian King Gentius and Teuta. Their legacy influenced Diocletian creates the province of Prevalis and Slavic Settlement & Rise of Duklja.
